nodes.name: test_local_mode.py
nodes.summary: Tests CLI local mode: SQLite single-file storage, the full approval-interrupt round-trip, and the contract that the agent event stream must be fully consumed before resume (early break silently loses the interrupt).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pytest async markers plus monkeypatching of the LLM client and singleton checkpointer reset to isolate each workspace.

nodes.name: TestApprovalRoundTrip
nodes.summary: End-to-end approval tests asserting writes are held until approved, denied on reject, no done event while awaiting approval, and that breaking early on approval_required loses the interrupt (regression guard).

nodes.name: TestLocalBootstrap
nodes.summary: Verifies local-mode bootstrap presets a no-database environment (SQLite backend, auth off, A2A off) while still respecting explicitly set env vars.

nodes.name: test_plan.py
nodes.summary: Tests the task-planning external scratchpad: strict validation of model-supplied plan steps, and that the plan actually lands in graph state and survives the checkpointer rather than only appearing in a message.

nodes.name: TestNormalize
nodes.summary: Validation tests asserting normalize accepts well-formed and plain-string plans, rejects multiple in-progress steps and malformed input, and produces actionable error messages.

nodes.name: TestPlanReachesGraphState
nodes.summary: Integration tests asserting the plan merges into graph state via tools_node, emits plan_updated events, replaces (not appends) in the reducer, and survives checkpoint persistence across turns.

nodes.name: test_sandbox.py
nodes.summary: Tests the command sandbox by asserting actual interception behavior (not config correctness): workspace stays usable while outside-workspace reads/writes are blocked, plus bwrap argv construction and private-tmp isolation.
nodes.languageNotes: Guards against the most dangerous sandbox failure mode (looks enabled but is a no-op) by actually reading/writing paths outside the workspace.

nodes.name: TestBackendDetection
nodes.summary: Tests that backend detection is capability-based (verified by actually running, not by binary/ABI presence), honest about no protection, and correctly scopes Landlock claims to filesystem only.

nodes.name: TestActualIsolation
nodes.summary: Live interception tests (skipped without a backend) proving workspace I/O works while outside-workspace file reads and writes are blocked, and that command output reports the active backend.

nodes.name: test_telemetry.py
nodes.summary: Tests OpenTelemetry tracing by capturing real spans with an in-memory exporter and asserting the span tree shape (parent/child nesting and shared trace id) rather than mere instrumentation presence.
nodes.languageNotes: Works around OpenTelemetry's set-once provider restriction by swapping the internal _TRACER_PROVIDER reference, and locks down span-across-yield behavior that PEP 568 leaves undefined.

nodes.name: TestRunAgentTracing
nodes.summary: Non-streaming tracing tests asserting agent.turn span-tree structure, GenAI attributes and token usage on chat spans, one chat span per turn, nested tool spans, and error status on failed turns.

nodes.name: TestStreamAgentTracing
nodes.summary: Streaming tracing tests asserting spans survive async-generator yields (children stay nested under agent.turn rather than flattening to roots) and that all spans in a turn share one trace id.

nodes.name: test_regressions.py
nodes.summary: Regression suite for silent-failure and authorization bugs: test isolation (blackhole DBs), LangGraph persistence API usage, RAG delete/namespace/context wrapping, tenant authorization, prompt accumulation, single-LLM-call-per-turn, and tool-node truncation/concurrency.

nodes.name: TestAuthzRegressions
nodes.summary: Authorization regressions: request bodies carry no tenant_id, tenant resolution rejects unlisted tenants and ignores client headers when multi-tenant is off, session ops take an owner filter, admin role is encoded in the JWT, and admin-only endpoints declare require_admin.

nodes.name: TestRagRegressions
nodes.summary: RAG regressions: delete_kb actually deletes indexed chunks, knowledge-base namespaces are tenant-scoped under multi-tenant mode, and retrieved context wraps untrusted content with explicit document boundaries.

nodes.name: test_unit.py
nodes.summary: Fast pure-logic unit tests with no DB/LLM/network dependencies: calculator safe evaluation, time tool, tool registry, LLM message-format conversions, in-memory store, profile fallback, config parsing, skills, security, auth, multi-tenant namespacing, RAG chunking, cost estimation, and rate-limit identity.

nodes.name: TestCalculator
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the calculator tool's safe-expression evaluation: arithmetic, power, functions, negative numbers, invalid-expression rejection, and division-by-zero handling.

nodes.name: TestAuth
nodes.summary: Unit tests for authentication primitives: password hash/verify round-trip and uniqueness, JWT create/decode, invalid-token rejection, and safe truncation of over-long passwords.
